Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 10, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - High School Youth Minister Jeff Gibbons, Church of Saint Thomas More
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS - No presentations are scheduled on this agenda.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC/BSD/CDC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Second Reading of Ordinances (CC)
1.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-15, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 13.04.090 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Reimbursement Agreements."
2.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-16, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 17.36.060 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Reimbursement Agreements."
3.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-17, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 19.08.100 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Reimbursement Agreements."
4.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-18, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 19, Chapter 19.08, Adding Sections 19.08.012, 19.08.014, and 19.08.016 of the Vista Development Code Relating to Excavations in New Streets and Restoration of Streets after Excavation."
5.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-19, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Procedures for Modifying Class Specifications."
6.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-20, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 18, Chapter 18.72 of the Vista Development Code with Respect to Certain Unpermitted Single Family Buildings and Accessory Uses."
C5.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending April 30, 2008 (CC)
C6.
Levy of Special Tax for Community Facility Districts for FY 2008-2009 (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , for Community Facilities District No. 92-1 (North County Square);
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , for Community Facilities District No. 90-2 (Hacienda Drive and Buena Vista Creek); and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , for Community Facilities District No. 2000-1 (Hacienda Gateway Restructuring).
C7.
Encina Wastewater Authority Budget for FY 2008-2009 (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- ; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- .
C8.
Agreement for Professional Engineering Services (CC)
C9.
As-Needed Geotechnical Engineering Services Agreements (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an agreement with Vinje and Middleton Engineering, Inc., in an amount not to exceed $100,000, and authorizing the Mayor to sign the agreement; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an agreement with Ninyo and Moore, in an amount not to exceed $100,000, and authorizing the Mayor to sign the agreement.
C10.
Notice of Completion and Change Order No. 5 for the 2007-2008 Asphalt Rehabilitation Project (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Change Order No. 5 to the 2007-2008 Asphalt Rehabilitation Project; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the Notice of Completion for the 2007-2008 Asphalt Rehabilitation Project.
C11.
CalHome Grant Program (CDC)
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Appointments to Various Commissions and Committees (CC)
1.
Confirm the Mayor's annual appointments;
2.
Confirm the Mayor's appointment to fill an unscheduled vacancy on the Public Arts Commission; and
3.
Appoint two members to the Planning Commission.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Regional Transportation Improvement Plan (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public testimony on the City's Regional Transportation Improvement Program; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , adopting the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2009 through 2013.
PH2.
Zoning Code Amendment for Large Family Day Care Homes (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public testimony regarding the proposed amendment to the Development Code; and
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 18 of the Vista Development Code with Respect to Large Family Day Care Homes."
PH3.
Appeal of Planning Commission Denial of PC11-239 (Large Family Day Care Home), Lucy Coyle, Applicant (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public testimony regarding a Minor Use Permit for a large family day care home at 1440 Portofino Drive; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Minor Use Permit for a large family day care home at 1440 Portofino Drive.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
